summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release on New Residential Construction for August 2022 (released September 20, 2022). Contributes seasonally adjusted data for units under construction (Table 4a) and housing completions (Table 5a) for buildings with five or more units to the task. Specifically, the document reports a 3.3% month-over-month increase in units under construction (5+ units) and a 20.7% month-over-month decrease in completions (5+ units). Consequently, this document enables the evaluation of August 2022 against the "shadow inventory growth" criteria, indicating the construction growth did not exceed the required 5% threshold for that month. Coverage is limited to August 2022 within the task's 2022/08–2025/05 range.
